description_en: Embeds a C2PA digital signature into a user-uploaded image and returns the download URL
description_zh: 对用户上传的图片嵌入C2PA数字签名并返回下载地址
name: SignUserImage

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. Make sure the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be signed. HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待签名图片的 URL 地址。支持 HTTP/HTTPS 链接。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the image to be signed in OSS. When you use `ObjectKey`, make sure the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待签名图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: object_key

Algorithm.description_en: The algorithm used for signing, such as ps256 or es256
Algorithm.description_zh: 签名使用的算法，如 ps256、es256 等

CertificateSubject.description_en: The subject information of the signing certificate

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value "OK" is returned if the request succeeds
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request succeeds
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value "success" is returned if the request succeeds
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"

ObjectKey.description_en: The ObjectKey of the signed image in OSS. You can use this value for subsequent API calls
ObjectKey.description_zh: 已签名图片在 OSS 中的 ObjectKey，可用于后续接口调用

SignTime.description_en: The signing time in ISO 8601 format, such as `2026-01-15T08:30:00Z`

SignedImageUrl.description_en: The pre-signed download URL of the signed image
SignedImageUrl.description_zh: 已签名图片的预签名下载地址

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
